g.text: LED1 initially DNP: qualify exact stock voltage/pinout/current. No LED power boost.

g.desc: LED1 initially DNP: qualify exact stock voltage/pinout/current. No LED power boost.

g.text: 0 bit H/L=300/1000ns; 1 bit=700/600ns; reset >=300us LOW (J2 RMT profile).

g.desc: 0 bit H/L=300/1000ns; 1 bit=700/600ns; reset >=300us LOW (J2 RMT profile).

g.text: Text/boxes/arrows explain the circuit; they are not electrical wires.

g.text: R14 holds OFF; D3 handles inductive transients. Verify actual buzzer current.

g.desc: R14 holds OFF; D3 handles inductive transients. Verify actual buzzer current.

g.text: ERC SOURCE DECLARATIONS — SOFTWARE ONLY, NO PARTS TO BUY

g.desc: ERC SOURCE DECLARATIONS — SOFTWARE ONLY, NO PARTS TO BUY

g.text: C34/C35 bypass both U6 rails; C28 bypasses LED. R13 damps; R42/R43 pull data low.

g.desc: C34/C35 bypass both U6 rails; C28 bypasses LED. R13 damps; R42/R43 pull data low.

g.text: Q5 switches raw SYS_IN; R41 pulls gate off. U6 translates 3.3V GPIO48 to LED_PWR.

g.desc: Q5 switches raw SYS_IN; R41 pulls gate off. U6 translates 3.3V GPIO48 to LED_PWR.

g.text: No new electrical components were added for this learning layout.

g.desc: No new electrical components were added for this learning layout.

g.text: Same global net name = same electrical connection, across all sheets.

g.desc: Same global net name = same electrical connection, across all sheets.

g.text: Equations use nominal values and stated assumptions; measure real behavior.

g.desc: Equations use nominal values and stated assumptions; measure real behavior.

g.text: PCB differential geometry and stackup still need impedance confirmation.

g.text: Reuse suitable stock. Every added part should earn its cost and board space.

g.desc: Reuse suitable stock. Every added part should earn its cost and board space.

g.text: R38/R39 22R reduce USB edge ringing near the MCU; not a voltage divider.

g.desc: R38/R39 22R reduce USB edge ringing near the MCU; not a voltage divider.

g.text: Fit 433MHz antenna before TX. Hand-solder bottom module after top reflow.

g.desc: Fit 433MHz antenna before TX. Hand-solder bottom module after top reflow.

g.text: R11 33R damps SCK; R37 10k keeps NSS high/unselected at startup.

g.desc: R11 33R damps SCK; R37 10k keeps NSS high/unselected at startup.

g.text: Cross on a pin = deliberate no-connect. DNP = staged omission.

g.desc: SW2 grounds MCU_EN; SW3 grounds GPIO0 for boot/cancel.
